title: Living Axe
body:
"A bamboo axe with strange natural powers... Absorbs the power of other trees, resulting in more force applied to chops. bamboo inflicts a temporary stasis of lighter weight on chopped materials"

The Living Axe, sometimes referred to as the Bamboo Axe, is an axe that can be purchased from the Radical Shack for $16,790.

Details

The Living Axe is a medium sized hatchet with a handle made of bamboo, and what appears to be green stone as its blade. In its default state, the Living Axe is simply faster than the Tall Refined Axe. Additionally, the Living Axe has four notable abilities:

  1. The axe gains more swing power the more rooted trees are nearby; this is most easily noticed in Uncertainty Cave due to the high density of Mushrooms.
  2. it makes any tree it lands the finishing chop on nearly weightless, which allows for carrying around heavy trees like Redwood and Petrified Oak as if they weigh nothing. Although the description claims that this weightlessness is only temporary, it lasts indefinitely.
  3. As of the 1.61.0 update, it allows fallen trees to retain their leaves, allowing for more decoration options.
  4. And finally, added in the 1.62.0 update, the axe has the ability to cut down trees bearing fruit without any of them rotting, unlike all other axes, which makes every fruit have a chance of rotting, making them disappear after a few seconds of doing so.

Trivia

  • This axe was part of the first ever Secret Friday Update.
  • It is the first axe added to have special abilities.
  • Despite the fact that handle is made to resemble a bamboo, the Bamboo has a completely different design, lacking the stem rings.
  • This axe does not remove leaves off chopped trees unlike other axes.
